name: The Distrustful Blacksmith
description: Elara told me I need a special, non-metallic tool to harvest the Mindbloom Petal. She said only Baelor the Blacksmith knows how to make one from obsidian, but he's wary of strangers.

1.name: Commission the Glimmering Trowel
1.description: I need to ask Baelor about crafting an 'obsidian tool'.

fail_response.content: An obsidian tool? Why would I make a rare thing like that for a stranger? I'm busy. Get lost.
